question.text: A black body of temperature $T$ is inside chamber of temperature $T_0$. Now, the closed chamber is slightly opened to sun such that temperature of black body $(T)$ and chamber $\left(T_0\right)$ remains constant.

options.text: Black body will absorb more radiation
Black body will absorb less radiation

solution.text: Since, the temperature of black body is constant, total heat absorbed $=$ total heat radiated.
